title: Narration
description: The narration spec an agent hands to explainer_narrate. Field defaults mirror the reference implementation that consumes this document.

voice.description: Kokoro voice id, or a blend such as "af_bella(2)+af_sky(1)". Blends are resolved server-side.

speed.description: Speech rate multiplier passed straight through to Kokoro.

fps.description: Frame rate the measured timings are converted to. Must match the composition.

langCode.description: Optional Kokoro language code. Inferred from the voice when omitted.

segments.description: Ordered narration segments. One timings entry is produced per segment, in this order.

id.description: Stable scene identifier. Reappears as the id of the matching timings segment.

text.description: What the voice says. Empty text yields a silent segment of holdSeconds length.

holdSeconds.description: Minimum on-screen duration. Silence is appended when the narration is shorter, so an animation can finish or a beat can land.
